negative_reviews.author: Valmont Blaton
negative_reviews.text: The only good thing was my friend and my beer. All the reste BELLOW average

negative_reviews.author: KT
negative_reviews.text: The sashimi was okay, tempura was good, anything with rice is terrible. Will not go back again.

negative_reviews.author: Antheia B
negative_reviews.text:
Far from authentic, not sanitary and highly overpriced for the quality of food. I sat and watched the chefs pull pre-cut slices of raw fish out of a bag or get given them on plates from the back. The least you could do for charging your customers 88£ each is give them fresh ingredients. Everything was pulled from bags and boxes.

The online images do not match what you serve. Soya sauce is for some reason in a beautician bottle pipette. An insult to Japanese food, a tourist trap at best.

****

Edit: I didn't ask for an Al summary on Japanese culture. I'm Asian myself, my review was never criticism of Japanese culture, but the lack of cleanliness and quality in your restaurant.

Instead of asking Al to teach you about "1. Neta-Bako", maybe learn how to take criticism.

****
